prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a new full-bleed background illustration for the traveler passport summary card in the Polish camping community mobile app RazemGo. Artwork only, not an app screenshot. Square composition.
Primary request: a welcoming, richly painted travel scene that fits an established watercolor camping app. A calm mountain lake, pine trees, a curving walking path and softly layered blue-green mountains in warm morning light. On the RIGHT side of the foreground, a small travel journal with an unlettered muted teal cover and an unlabelled folded paper map resting on a weathered wooden picnic ledge, with a few subtle souvenir-like paper corners. The book should feel like a personal traveler passport, not an official national passport. No readable writing.
Composition: edge-to-edge continuous scene. The main journal and map stay fully in frame in the right third, around x=70–94%, y=46–78%, with a comfortable margin. The left 60% is serene low-detail soft meadow and lake, to accommodate dark live UI text and a progress bar later. Keep the upper left and lower left quiet. Landscape details and pine silhouettes are strongest on the right. No baked-in text wash or white blank block: paint the complete background; gradients will be added in code. Preserve recognizability when the square is cropped slightly for a roughly square or gently portrait mobile card.
Style: warm, hand-painted watercolor and gouache, fine visible paper grain, delicate organic brushwork and painterly foliage, natural proportions, like an illustrated camping travel poster. Sage greens, pine greens, soft turquoise, pale blue mountains, creamy sunlit highlights and a restrained amber glow. Soft natural light, inviting and peaceful. Match the spirit of charming watercolor camping and mountain illustrations, with enough depth and texture to feel like the other image cards in the app.
Constraints: opaque artwork, no lettering, no numbers, no typography, no logos, no country emblems, no watermarks, no UI, no medals, no badges, no decorative frame. No people, animals, vehicles or tents. No glossy 3D, no flat vector artwork, no photorealistic stock photo aesthetic.
optimization: Generated raster encoded as a 1024 × 1024 JPEG, quality 88. No scene changes. Text and gradients are separate UI layers.
